records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the quarter ended July 1, 2023, 36% of revenue was recognized at the point in time control transferred to the customer.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The twelve-month backlog increased in the third quarter of 2023 compared with the third quarter of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The twelve-month backlog also increased in Space and Defense Controls across our defense control programs as well as our space vehicle programs.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the first three quarters of 2023 compared to the same periods of 2022, gross margin decreased due mostly to the same factors as the third quarter.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash used by investing activities in the first three quarters of 2022 included $107 million for capital expenditures, as we increased investments in facilities to support growth.
